segments.name: ACV segment
segments.description: Operates a wholesale auction marketplace for business-to-business used vehicle sales, plus transportation, financing and data services for licensed dealers and commercial partners.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined that it operates in a single reporting segment (the "ACV segment").

revenueModel.text: Licensed automotive dealerships and other commercial automotive enterprises pay for access to the wholesale auction marketplace and related transportation, financing and data services.
revenueModel.evidence: The ACV segment provides a wholesale auction marketplace to dealers and derives its revenues primarily from North America.
